en.title: Kate Winslet, Maxine Peake Lead 'The Unheard' in High-Stakes Netflix Thriller
en.summary: Two powerhouse actresses are set to star in a new Netflix limited series, 'The Unheard.' The show promises a 'Thelma & Louise'-style ride with a dark twist, exploring vengeance and desperation.
en.body:
Prepare for a gripping new limited series from Netflix, as Oscar-winner **Kate Winslet** and BAFTA nominee **Maxine Peake** are set to lead **‘The Unheard’**. This British drama, penned by the acclaimed **Jack Thorne** (known for his work on **‘Adolescence’** and **‘Toxic Town’**), promises a tense, character-focused narrative that will have audiences on the edge of their seats.

Details are still emerging, but the series is described as a high-stakes, 'Thelma & Louise'-style vengeance drama. The official logline teases a story about two sisters who go on the run after an act of vengeance goes tragically wrong. As they are desperately pursued, fundamental questions arise: What drove them to such a reckless act? And was escape ever truly part of their plan? The narrative is set to delve deep into their motivations and the consequences of their actions, exploring the blurred lines between justice and desperation.

## A Tale of Sisters on the Run

The collaboration between **Winslet** and **Peake** alone is enough to generate significant buzz. Both actresses are celebrated for their ability to embody complex, nuanced characters, and seeing them as sisters on the run from the law, or perhaps something worse, is a tantalizing prospect. **Jack Thorne** has a proven track record with Netflix, consistently delivering compelling British dramas that resonate with audiences. His involvement as writer and executive producer, alongside **Winslet** and **Peake** themselves, suggests a project with a clear creative vision and a commitment to quality storytelling. The series is expected to begin filming in 2027, with a projected release on Netflix in 2028, giving creators ample time to craft this ambitious five-part story.

## What This Means for Fans

For fans of character-driven thrillers and prestige television, **‘The Unheard’** shapes up to be a major event. The premise taps into timeless themes of sisterhood, rebellion, and the pursuit of justice, albeit through a lens of potentially fatal miscalculation. The 'Thelma & Louise' comparison immediately conjures images of iconic cinematic moments and a deep dive into female agency and the consequences of defying societal norms. With **Thorne** at the helm and two of the most respected actresses of their generation in the lead roles, the series is poised to offer a profound exploration of human nature under extreme pressure. The anticipation for this project is palpable, with many eager to see how **Winslet** and **Peake** will navigate the emotional and physical journey of these sisters.

## What's Next

While filming is slated for 2027 and a release is expected in 2028, specific details regarding the production timeline, further casting, and the exact plot points beyond the core premise have not yet been announced. Fans will be eagerly awaiting further updates from Netflix and the production team.

content_raw: Picture (L to R): Kate Winslet and Maxine Peake lead The Unheard Academy Award-winning actress Kate Winslet and BAFTA nominee Maxine Peake will play two sisters on the run in Netflix’s brand-new limited series from Adolescence creator Jack Thorne. Filming will begin sometime in 2027, and it is expected to release on Netflix in 2028. Here’s what we know so far. The Unheard is an upcoming British Netflix Original limited series created by writer Jack Thorne and director Mounia Akl (House of Guinness) . Executive producers include Mark Herbert and Emily Feller (Warp Films), Hannah Walters and Stephen Graham (Matriarch Productions), and Dede Gardner, Jeremy Kleiner, and Nina Wolarsky (Plan B). Both stars, Kate Winslet and Maxine Peake, also serve as executive producers alongside Thorne. Since 2025, Thorne has emerged as one of Netflix’s most prolific filmmakers, delivering gripping British dramas such as Toxic Town , Lord of the Flies , and the multi-award-winning Adolescence . He also penned and produced Enola Holmes 3 , and his strong relationship with the streamer is set to continue; he is currently collaborating once again with Millie Bobby Brown on her upcoming spy series co-starring David Harbour. Picture: Jack Thorne at the screening of Adolescence What is the plot of The Unheard ? Netflix has provided a logline for the series: “This limited series tells the story of two sisters who go on the run after an act of vengeance goes wrong. As they are desperately pursued, questions remain: What pushed them to this reckless act? And was it ever their intention to get away with it?” Who are the cast members of The Unheard ? So far, the only two cast members confirmed for the series are the leads, Kate Winslet and Maxine Peake. So far, Kate Winslet’s only appearance in a Netflix Original was the British drama Goodbye June (which she also directed). As one of the most sought-after British actresses of the last thirty years, Winslet boasts an incredible resume featuring cinematic landmarks like Titanic , Sense and Sensibility , Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind , The Holiday , and Avatar . A seven-time Academy Award nominee, she won Best Actress in 2009 for her performance in The Reader . Picture (L to R): Kate Winslet in The Reader, Goodbye June, and Avatar: Way of the Water Maxine Peake has previously starred in the Black Mirror episode “Metalhead” and lent her voice to Tish Murtha in Wendell & Wild for Netflix. A prolific staple of British television, her extensive credits include hits like Shameless and intense, character-driven miniseries such as  Anne , Three Girls , and Say Nothing . Her recent work also spans major streaming platforms, featuring in Riz Ahmed’s Amazon Prime series Bait and Apple TV+’s Last Seen .
